purpose: Compare only the color-sampling region on the same matched pose proposals. Not a replay of the original8-frame-anchor tracker.
initial_gallery: One fixed initialization frame per case; far slots from far_context, near slots from court. Both feature policies use exactly the same pose proposals. Missing anchor or pose stays unavailable.
negative_gallery: Eligible unassigned initialization far_context poses with minimum-area overlap<0.1 against every initialized native player box. Not certified nonplayers.
histogram: HSV12x4x4 normalized; Bhattacharyya distance. Rectangle uses15..85percent width,18..52percent height of the pose box. Torso is convex hull of shoulders and hips, each confidence>=0.5.
margin_source: Retained appearance margin; no calibration or sweep.
